title: Fix request guard middleware blocking local requests when API key is configured
description: MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware skips API key validation for loopback when AllowRemoteApi=false... except it doesn't — the guard logic lets loopback pass the remote check but then runs the API key check which rejects the request when no X-Api-Key header is present. Also, /api/admin/setup/status is not in the ApiKeyExemptUiPaths list despite being [AllowAnonymous]. Fix: skip API key validation for loopback requests when AllowRemoteApi=false; add /api/admin/setup/status prefix to exempt list. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P1-005
